mistakes.pattern: Chronic losing streak — 0/4 in last 7 days, all SL hits
mistakes.root_cause: Entry signals occur after trend has already moved, bot enters against momentum. All exits via SL, zero TP hits.
mistakes.fix: Consider disabling bot (auto-disable triggered: 10 trades, 10% WR < 30% threshold). Tighten entry criteria or reduce risk per trade from 1.07% to 0.5%.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Auto-disable any magic with <30% WR over 10+ trades. Review bot config if risk% exceeds 0.5%.

mistakes.pattern: News calendar broken since Jul 23 — ForexFactory 429/403 errors
mistakes.root_cause: ForexFactory JSON feed rate-limited (429). HTML scrape now returns 403 (blocked). Allowlisted IP?
mistakes.fix: Replace news feed source or disable news-check in bot code until replacement ready.
mistakes.prevention_rule: If news feed fails for 24+ consecutive hours, flag as CRITICAL — trading blind to news events.

mistakes.root_cause: Variable 'active_symbols' referenced before assignment in generate_report() in market_sentiment.py (line 359)
mistakes.fix: Fix the UnboundLocalError in market_sentiment.py or disable the sentiment filter in the bot.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Sentiment engine must be monitored for crashes. A silent crash leaves sentiment filter non-functional.

mistakes.pattern: Risk per trade at 1.07% exceeds FTMO-recommended 0.5%
mistakes.root_cause: Bot config likely uses risk_pct=0.01 (1%) instead of 0.005 (0.5%). Monte Carlo shows 100% pass rate at 0.5%, drops significantly at 1%.
mistakes.fix: Reduce risk_pct from 0.01 to 0.005 in propfirm_pass_bot.py config.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Every deployment must verify risk_pct is 0.005 (0.5%) for FTMO compliance.

mistakes.pattern: SL/TP tracking in state file not recording (sl_hits=0, tp_hits=0 despite 4 SL hits)
mistakes.root_cause: State persistence logic may not capture SL/TP exit reasons from MT5 deal comments, or deal comment parsing is broken.
mistakes.fix: Audit propfirm_pass_bot.py state file update logic for SL/TP tracking.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Verify SL/TP tracking reads d.comment field correctly after every trade close.

mistakes.pattern: 17+ zombie instances of propfirm_pass_bot.py accumulated — no PID lock cleanup on cron restart
mistakes.root_cause: Cron launcher(s) start new instances without killing old ones. Bots from C:/Hermess/bots/ and -u bots/ paths have no shared lock file.
mistakes.fix: Kill ALL propfirm_pass_bot.py instances, then restart single instance. Add lock-file check shared across both deployment paths.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Process count must be verified after every restart. More than 1 instance = zombie cascade.

mistakes.pattern: propfirm_pass_state.json MISSING — all trade tracking data lost
mistakes.root_cause: State file was deleted or never persisted. Bot starts fresh each time, losing consecutive loss count, SL/TP tracking, and daily trade limits.
mistakes.fix: Regenerate state file from MT5 history or restart bot with clean state generation logic.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Verify state file exists after every bot restart. Missing state = blind bot.

mistakes.pattern: Trades entered outside declared session window (01:29-02:12 UTC vs 07:00-15:00 UTC)
mistakes.root_cause: Timezone bug — bot uses local HKT time for session detection while declaring UTC window. Entries at HKT 09:29 fall in Asian session, not London/US.
mistakes.fix: Fix session detection to use datetime.now(timezone.utc) instead of datetime.now()
mistakes.prevention_rule: Cross-check every trade's UTC hour against declared session window. Off-window trades = timezone bug.

mistakes.pattern: GBPUSD and USDJPY bots also have zombie cascades (3 and 4 instances each)
mistakes.root_cause: Same cron launcher issue as propfirm_pass_bot.py — no cleanup between restarts.
mistakes.fix: Kill all instances of all bot types, restart cleanly with shared PID locks.
mistakes.prevention_rule: All bot types in the fleet must be checked for duplicate instances, not just the primary EURUSD bot.

mistakes.pattern: M780014 variant also losing (-$982.73 in 7 days, 1/1 W/L = 50% but negative PnL)
mistakes.root_cause: Second magic number variant of the same strategy, same structural flaws. No isolation from M780012.
mistakes.fix: Disable M780014 alongside M780012 until root cause of strategy failure is resolved.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Variant bots must be independently evaluated. Same strategy = same failure mode.

mistakes.pattern: News calendar feed IS working (returned 22 events including FOMC), contradicting earlier report
mistakes.root_cause: The ForexFactory issue may have been intermittent or specific to a different endpoint. Current caching feed works.
mistakes.fix: No fix needed — verified functional. Update mistakes ledger to reflect resolution.
mistakes.prevention_rule: Verify each reported issue independently before recording. Cross-reference cache vs live feed.

mistakes.root_cause: Account dropped from $100,940 peak to $90,035 current. Static FTMO DD ≈ 9.96% (just under 10% limit). Risk supervisor correctly flagged.
